matrix_name.name: epoxy resin

matrix_name.name: epoxy resin
matrix_name.description: Epoxy 5015 resin with curing agent (resin:curing agent = 100:30 by weight); composite fabricated by vacuum-assisted resin infusion (VARI).

fillers.name: carbon fiber
fillers.description: Plain woven carbon fiber fabric (T300, 12K); carbon fibers pretreated by desizing and oxidizing; carbon fiber surface coated with Ti3C2Tx MXene via electrophoretic deposition (EPD). MXene mass fraction on CF fabric reported as 13 wt% (relative to CF fabric).

fillers.name: titanium carbide MXene (Ti3C2Tx)
fillers.description: MXene nanoparticles deposited onto carbon fiber surface by EPD (20 V, 30 min) using MgCl2·6H2O in aqueous suspension; MXene loading on CF fabric reported as 13 wt% (relative to CF fabric).

matrix_name.name: epoxy resin

fillers.name: carbon fiber
fillers.description: Plain woven carbon fiber fabric (T300, 12K); carbon fibers pretreated by desizing and oxidizing; carbon fiber surface coated with thermally annealed/reduced Ti3C2Tx MXene (rMXene) after EPD.

fillers.name: titanium carbide MXene (Ti3C2Tx)
fillers.description: MXene nanoparticles deposited onto carbon fiber surface by EPD, then thermally annealed at 350 °C for 6 h under N2 to reduce oxygen-containing groups (rMXene-CF). MXene loading on CF fabric reported as 13 wt% (relative to CF fabric, prior to annealing).
